title: Why Clefairy Gather Under a Full Moon
premise: Clefairy is rarely seen, except on full-moon nights when groups gather from all over to dance.
audiencePromise: Follow the clues from Clefairy's rarity to its strange full-moon gathering and quiet return at dawn.
openLoop: Why do rare Clefairy gather from all over under full moons?
payoff: The full moon reveals not one Clefairy, but a dancing gathering surrounded by an abnormal magnetic field before dawn brings mountain sleep.
engagementQuestion: Would you seek the dance, or avoid its magnetic field?

voice.instructions: Use a hushed, curious tone. Start with surprise, then build tension through each reveal. Slow slightly on full moon and dawn. Make the final choice direct and playful.
